title: Headcount + Price Sensitivity — Bridge Plan (Aug 2026)
body:
EXEC SUMMARY:
This is a short, operational bridge plan to preserve runway if we see a sustained 15–30% compression in effective per-token revenue over the next 3 quarters. Unlike the larger scenario decks, this is an actionable headcount and pricing-sensitivity sheet with immediate hiring gates and a proposed two-phase pause/carry approach for mid-Senior IC hiring. Aim is to protect Q4 hiring for SRE/serving-runtime critical roles while delaying lower-immediate-impact roles in Console/Docs.

KEY ASSUMPTIONS (quick):
- Baseline ARR trajectory unadjusted: $86M run-rate by EOY.
- Effective per-token price pressure scenarios modeled at -10%, -20%, -30%.
- Hiring pipeline: 24 open reqs (mix Eng/Prod/CS/Infra).
- Average fully-loaded hire cost (first 12 months): $180k USD.
- Conservatively assume cost savings realization lag of 6–8 weeks after hiring freeze.

SENSITIVITY SUMMARY (high level):
- -10% price => runway +3.0 months if we pause 60% of open non-critical hires and implement modest discount cap.
- -20% price => runway +6.7 months with 80% pause and 10% reduction in contractor spend.
- -30% price => runway +9+ months but requires targeted reductions in marketing and delayed product launches.

IMMEDIATE HIRING-GATE RULES (proposal):
1) Freeze: block all new non-critical offers from Aug 28 until finance approves exceptions.
2) Exceptions: auto-approve for: SRE (critical on-call), Serving Runtime (GPU infra), Security & Compliance.
3) Soft-hold: Console, Docs, Growth eng — interview pipeline allowed but offers deferred.
4) Contractor curb: reduce external contractors by 25% within 30 days; prioritize ramp-down with lowest ramp-to-impact ratio.

ACTIONABLE COST/PRICE COUPLER TABLE (simple sheet snapshot):
Role,Jul-26 (FTE),Aug-26 (FTE),Sep-26 (FTE),Oct-26 (FTE),Notes
Engineering - Serving Runtime,12,13,13,13,Keep hires for capacity
SRE,6,6,7,7,1 critical hire queued
Platform Eng,8,8,8,7,Pause 1 req Oct start
Console & Tooling,10,10,9,8,Delay two senior hires
Developer Experience,4,4,3,3,Hold until price stabilizes
Product - Hosted API,7,7,6,6,Delay PM hire by 8 weeks
Customer Success,9,9,8,8,Curb contractor CSMs
Finance & Legal,5,5,5,5,Keep headcount (compliance tasks)
Totals,61,62,59,57,

PRICING SENSITIVITY QUICK MODEL (snap):
Scenario,Price Delta,Estimated Revenue Delta /mo,Hires Paused (FTE),Runway Delta (months)
Base,0%,0,0,+0
Mild Shock,-10%,-$0.8M,6,+3.0
Medium Shock,-20%,-$1.9M,9,+6.7
Severe Shock,-30%,-$3.2M,12,+9.4

Notes on the model: revenue deltas use current token mix and average ARPU per customer cohort; assumes no immediate price increases. Hires paused include contractors reallocated. Runway delta is approximate and includes 60% realization of salary cost reductions in first quarter and 90% by Q2.

MECHANICS: WHAT FINANCE WILL EXECUTE
- Weekly snapshot each Friday: actual spend vs plan, new offers declined/approved, contractor reduction progress.
- Maintain a live spreadsheet (owner: Maya Chen) and a one-page summary for execs (max 1 page).
- Pull API: token usage + revenue by segment to recompute sensitivity if price shift > 5% MoM.

COMMUNICATION PLAN
- HR/Recruiting: message templates ready for deferred offers; internal comms draft in Drive (owner: Priya).
- Engineering leadership: call on Aug 26 to review exceptions list and finalize two hires for Serving Runtime.
- Execs: 1-pager to CEO and CFO on Aug 27 with staging triggers.

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS
- If price recovery is partial and slow (15% over 6 months), do we rehire quickly or keep a smaller org? (Need scenario A/B decision tree)
- Contractor legal implications for staggered terminations across regions.
- Customer churn risk if we pass price increases — offset with committed discounts for enterprise.

RAW CALC EXCERPT (for auditors / FP&A):
Monthly cadence (simplified):
- Payroll burn baseline: $3.6M/month (includes benefits/taxes).
- Pause 10 FTE across mid-senior = immediate cash delta ~ $150k/month (first month partial) => modeled as $1.6M over 12 months avoided.
- Contractor saves: $220k/month if 25% reduction executed.

REFERENCES AND LINKS:
- JIRA FIN-4822 (pricing compression triggers)
- Confluence: Price Shock Playbook (runbook for bad-case)
- GitHub cost-sim: branch 'price-scan' contains the exact sim used for revenue delta numbers.

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Keep the model coarsely conservative — prefer underpromising runway improvements.
- Check regional hiring laws before mass contractor pause (EMEA vs US notice periods).
- Align with Sales on discount floor; need a hard 6-week no-extra-discount policy if freeze engaged.

NEXT STEPS (this week):
- Aug 25: circulate freeze + exceptions draft to Eng leads (owner: Maya).
- Aug 26: leadership call to greenlight 2 serving-runtime hires and 1 SRE.
- Aug 28: if price delta exceeds -12% MoM, auto-trigger hiring pause and exec notification.

END OF SHEET — working doc.
